title: Create: AlcoCraft+
description: Bring Create automation to AlcoCraft+ brewing. Pipe water into your keg, pump the finished beer back out, and fill mugs at a Create Spout.
body:
# Create: AlcoCraft+                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

A Create integration addon for **AlcoCraft+**. It turns the keg into a fully automatable brewery — no more right-clicking buckets and mugs by hand.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

## Features
- **Piped water in, beer out** — feed your keg water through Create fluid pipes and pump the finished beer straight out the other side.
- **Spout filling** — fill empty mugs automatically with a Create Spout (`create:filling` recipes), one mug per serving.
- **Mugs as fluid containers** — a filled beer mug can be used as a Smart Fluid Pipe filter and drained in an Item Drain.
- **12 beer fluids** — one for every AlcoCraft+ beer, tinted to match.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

> Ingredient automation (hoppers, Mechanical Arm) already lives in AlcoCraft+ itself — this addon adds the fluid side of things.

## Requirements
- [AlcoCraft+](https://modrinth.com/mod/alcocraft)
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
